leads.claim: The crew observed the superstructure of an aircraft carrier during the recovery phase of the Apollo 17 mission.
leads.why: The mention of an aircraft carrier is a prosaic reference to the standard naval recovery vessel used for Apollo splashdowns, not a UAP-related material recovery.
leads.quote: saw the superstructure of an aircraft carrier

doc_verdict: The document contains no information suggesting the recovery or custody of UAP-related material; the snippet refers to standard naval recovery operations.
